scope: Portable reported zero-centre study, launcher integration, saved reports and regression coverage
checks: Bundled map hashes and original author SCS fitting provenance
Exact frozen production maps, target, radii and step sizes
No refitting or step adaptation in reported-study runs
Separate warmup and exact first-third production burn-in
Repeated states retained and functional ESS computed without thinning
Complete manifests, exact-value tables and all five figure families
Both reported batches and every active-method chain retained
limitations: Quick checks establish execution and provenance, not convergence or sampler rankings.
Some Quick executions overlapped in time; their rates are not performance evidence.
Local validation does not substitute for the published revision's platform CI status.
The Numba option extends the reported JAX experiment using the same maps and parameters.
